verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence confirm broad LLM support (gpt-oss, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi) and Hugging Face-based model search/download, plus MLX model support on Apple Silicon, but nothing in the evidence explicitly confirms MoE architectures, multi-modal models, or embedding-model support. missing for 10: explicit documentation or community proof of MoE architecture support, multi-modal (vision/audio) model support, and embedding model support, plus any claim of 'hundreds' of architectures.
